# Yang Yang

This website is prepared for **ISSS608 Visual Analytics and Applications** as a portfolio of coursework, hands-on practice, and applied visual analytics learning.
:::

:::: vaa-profile-grid
::: vaa-profile-panel
### Portfolio Focus

The portfolio documents a practical journey through visual analytics methods in R. It moves from graphical foundations into statistical visualisation, interactive graphics, network analysis, text analysis, time-oriented data, geospatial mapping, and information dashboard design.
:::

::: vaa-profile-panel
### Tools and Workflow

[R]{.vaa-tag} [Quarto]{.vaa-tag} [ggplot2]{.vaa-tag} [tidyverse]{.vaa-tag} [tmap]{.vaa-tag} [network]{.vaa-tag} [text mining]{.vaa-tag} [dashboard design]{.vaa-tag}

The website is built as a reproducible Quarto site so that code, visual output, interpretation, and navigation sit together in one consistent learning artefact.
:::
::::

## Learning Approach

The coursework is treated as more than a collection of exercises. Each page records how a visual method works, what kind of question it can support, and how design choices affect interpretation. The goal is to make the portfolio useful both as a submission website and as a reference for future analytical work.

:::: vaa-feature-grid
::: vaa-feature-card
### Practical

Exercises are organised around real analytical tasks: comparing distributions, mapping spatial patterns, identifying network structures, and summarising dashboards.
:::

::: vaa-feature-card
### Exploratory

The gallery and method pathways let visitors browse by topic instead of reading the site only in exercise order.
:::

::: vaa-feature-card
### Professional

The site uses a consistent visual system, direct navigation, and concise page summaries to make the coursework easier to review.
:::
::::

## What This Portfolio Demonstrates

::: vaa-check-list
- The ability to translate raw data into readable visual evidence.
- Awareness of visual design choices such as colour, layout, annotation, scale, and comparison.
- Hands-on experience with static, interactive, geospatial, network, text, temporal, and dashboard-oriented methods.
- A reproducible workflow using R, Quarto, and HTML output.
:::

::: vaa-note
Prepared by Yang Yang for ISSS608 Visual Analytics and Applications.
:::
